name: Baltazar Mail
description: A fast, ad-free client for Yahoo Mail that reuses your existing Yahoo sign-in. Not affiliated with Yahoo.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.yusercontent.com https://*.mail.yahoo.com; media-src blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://mail.yahoo.com https://*.mail.yahoo.com https://api.github.com; frame-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
